tasks.label: 🔨 Rebuild Codespace (apply Docker/observability fix)
tasks.detail: Runs `gh codespace rebuild`. Required after pulling a branch that changes .devcontainer/devcontainer.json. Takes ~5-8 min; VS Code reconnects automatically.

tasks.label: 🛰️ Restart Observability Stack (Grafana/Prometheus/Loki/Tempo/OTel)
tasks.detail: Re-runs start_observability.sh. Useful if Mission Control panels stopped responding. Does NOT require a rebuild.

tasks.label: 📊 Tail Observability Boot Log
tasks.detail: Watch .observability/boot.log live to see what start_observability.sh did.
